scientific_integrity: Analytic exact proof supported by deterministic numerical checks. Classical tent convolution and general two-interval uniqueness are not claimed new. Publication-priority risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Two equal-width separated intervals; complete continuous squared Fourier intensity in L2. Global gap modulus compares equal known widths, local Gram permits simultaneous width changes; no discrete/noisy algorithm or unequal-width theorem.
title: Sharp local and global Fourier-intensity stability of two equal intervals
